scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline picture-book painting for the graded-reading story “Rapunzel”
Primary request: depict the opening garden scene from paragraph 0: at night, Rapunzel’s father quietly gathers a few leafy greens from the edge of the witch’s garden.
Scene/backdrop: a small cottage beyond a low garden hedge, rows of broad leafy vegetables in a quiet moonlit garden, deep forest shapes behind it.
Subject: one worried middle-aged husband in simple muted brown clothes bends to gather a small bundle of greens, moving carefully and looking toward the cottage. Keep the action gentle and readable.
Style/medium: children’s storybook painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background. Much simpler than a detailed cover painting.
Composition/framing: landscape close to the project's 12:7 inline shape; medium-wide view with the man and greens as clear focal points, two or three broad depth layers.
Lighting/mood: cool moonlight with a small warm glow at the cottage window; restrained suspense, not frightening.
Color palette: midnight indigo, muted teal and sage, warm ivory and a little ochre.
Constraints: original character and setting design; no lettering, title, border, frame, or watermark.
Avoid: visible witch, confrontation, baby, prince, magic effects, text, ornate detail, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense texture, violence.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: a wide landscape inline picture-book painting for the graded-reading story “Rapunzel”.
Input images: Image 1 is the story cover only for Rapunzel’s character identity and golden-hair palette; do not copy its tower portrait composition or detailed cover rendering. Image 2 is Kasa Jizō 01.webp for the approved smooth inline style only.
Primary request: illustrate the moment in paragraph 2 when the prince discovers how the witch enters the doorless tower: he secretly watches her climb Rapunzel’s long golden hair toward the high window.
Scene/backdrop: a tall simple stone tower at the edge of a quiet forest near evening. Show one small high window and the golden braid descending from it. Use only a few broad tree and hillside shapes; the tower has no door or stairs.
Subject: a young adult prince in an original, simple muted indigo-blue tunic, brown belt and boots watches from behind a tree in the foreground. At a distance, a middle-aged witch in a plain muted plum cloak climbs the golden braid toward the window. Rapunzel may appear only as a small calm silhouette at the window. Keep the prince hidden and the witch’s action matter-of-fact, not frightening.
Style/medium: gentle painted children’s-book art in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal texture, a few purposeful shadows and a quiet simplified background. Make it much flatter and simpler than the cover, with clear shapes and no ornate stone texture.
Composition/framing: full-bleed landscape close to the project’s 12:7 inline ratio. Let the tower and braid form one clear vertical shape on the right, with the small observing prince on the left and open space between them. Two or three depth layers only.
Lighting/mood: calm blue-hour evening, quiet discovery rather than danger.
Color palette: cool forest teal and indigo, warm stone-grey, soft ivory highlights, and the braid’s muted gold.
Constraints: this is the prince watching the witch climb, before he calls to Rapunzel or climbs himself. Exactly one prince and one witch; no threatening confrontation.
Avoid: a doorway or stairs in the tower, the prince climbing, a cut braid, Rapunzel leaving the tower, extra characters, violence, horror lighting, ornate cover detail, photorealism, glossy 3D, lettering, speech bubbles, labels, border, logo or watermark.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: a wide landscape inline picture-book painting for the graded-reading story “Rapunzel”.
Input images: Image 1 is the story cover only for Rapunzel’s face, golden hair and simple ivory clothing palette. Image 2 is Kasa Jizō 01.webp for the approved smooth inline style only. Image 3 is the newly generated prince-at-the-tower scene, supplied only for the prince’s face, hair and muted indigo clothing continuity; do not copy its exterior setting or composition.
Primary request: illustrate paragraph 3 as Rapunzel and the prince begin making a ladder together from the silk thread he brings each night.
Scene/backdrop: the quiet interior of the high stone tower room, with its single small window and a glimpse of the evening forest. Keep the stone, window and furniture simple and broad.
Subject: Rapunzel, a young woman with long golden hair and a plain ivory dress, sits near the window with the same young prince in muted indigo-blue and brown. They talk gently as he offers a small coil of silk thread; together they begin tying a few strands into the first short section of an unfinished ladder. Rapunzel’s hair is loose beside her but is not being used as the ladder. Their faces are calm and trusting.
Style/medium: gentle painted children’s-book art in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal texture, a few purposeful folds and quiet simplified background. Keep details simpler than the cover and use clean silhouettes.
Composition/framing: full-bleed landscape close to the project’s 12:7 inline ratio, medium view with both characters, the coil of silk and the short unfinished ladder section clearly readable. Two or three calm depth layers.
Lighting/mood: soft evening light with a small warm glow in the room; intimate, hopeful and restrained.
Color palette: warm ivory, soft gold hair, muted indigo, gentle stone-grey and quiet forest teal.
Constraints: show the beginning of their plan after Rapunzel has asked to leave, before the witch discovers anything. The ladder is only just starting; no escape has happened.
Avoid: a completed ladder, climbing out, the witch, cut hair, wilderness, reunion, extra characters, magic effects, lettering, symbols, captions, border, logo or watermark.
